screens.name: Submission detail page frame and action header
screens.purpose: Command bar for one GISA technical submission: status, provenance links, and the role-appropriate lifecycle actions (save/submit, approve/return, delete).
roles: Route is wrapped in ProtectedRoute, not RoleRoute, so ANY authenticated user can open it (web/src/App.tsx:135-142; web/src/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx:10-16)
Edit (Save draft / Submit): roles include raw string FIELD_WORKER or ADMIN AND status DRAFT or REJECTED (web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:162)
Review (Approve / Return): roles include REVIEWER or ADMIN AND status SUBMITTED (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:161,163)
Delete: ADMIN, or DRAFT owned by the current user (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:165-168)
Access sharing card: server flag submission.can_manage_permissions (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:164)
primaryTasks: Engineer: complete the GISA form and submit (or resubmit) it for review
Reviewer: approve the submission or return it for correction with a note
Anyone: orient (status, parent assessment/incident) and jump to photo evidence

responsive.layout: Single column page (space-y-4 p-4) inside AppShell; header is a flex-wrap row with a flex-wrap action cluster on the right; no Tailwind breakpoint classes in the header itself.
phoneRisks: Action cluster wraps to 2–3 rows at 375px (Photo evidence + Refresh + Save draft + Submit + •••), pushing the form below the fold (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:117-158)
Buttons are px-3 py-2 text-sm (~36px tall), below the 44px touch minimum (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:26)
Photo-heading count is only in a title tooltip, invisible on touch (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:119)
tabletRisks: Fits on one row at 768px only when no review actions are present; SUBMITTED + ADMIN shows 6 controls and wraps
desktopNotes: Reads well; the primary action is visually distinct (brand fill) from secondary bordered buttons
Overflow menu is absolutely positioned right-0 top-11 min-w-52, no outside-click or Escape close (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:145-156)

painPoints.issue: Role gating uses the raw string 'FIELD_WORKER' instead of the canonical GEOTECH_ENGINEER alias set from roleModel, so a user carrying only GEOTECH_ENGINEER gets a read-only form; likewise 'REVIEWER' is hard-coded rather than derived from the role model.

The submit comment (engineer) and the reviewer note (reviewer) are typed at the bottom of a very long page, while the Submit / Approve / Return buttons that consume them sit in the header; users can act without ever seeing the comment field.
painPoints.evidence: SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1282-1284 (placeholder even says 'when you submit for review from the header'), 1301-1307; SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:126-142

painPoints.issue: Refresh silently discards unsaved edits; there is no dirty-state indicator, no beforeunload guard, and no 'saved' confirmation.
Descriptor is rendered twice within ~40px (page h1 and header meta line), and owner is shown as 'user #N'.
Photo evidence is fetched twice on load (header and page), producing two independent loading states for the same numbers.
Delete relies on window.confirm and a hard window.location redirect, breaking SPA navigation and any in-flight state.
All validation and API errors surface in one banner under the header, far from the offending card (e.g. soil percentages in the Material card).
'•••' menu has aria-expanded but no role=menu, no Escape, and no outside-click dismissal.

strengths: Status-aware captions and a 'Resubmit for review' label when the record was returned (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:91-99; SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1181)
Back link resolves to the parent assessment rather than a generic list (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:77-79)
Destructive delete is tucked into an overflow menu and styled red; primary CTA uses the brand fill so hierarchy is clear (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:129,138,151)
REJECTED reason is surfaced as a banner right under the header (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1190-1192)

grid-cols-2 stored-value tiles at 375px give ~150px cells; values truncate with title-only overflow (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:49-51,134)

painPoints.issue: Three vocabularies for the same location facts on one screen: raw codes in the hero ('03', county code, '050'), 'District 3' + county name in the Report Header selects, and the compact descriptor in the h1.
Hero shows the STORED gisa values while the Report Header edits the DRAFT; after changing district in the card the hero keeps the old value until Save draft, with no explanation of the difference.
Mixed persistence model: map geometry autosaves on every sketch completion, while every other field waits for Save draft; the same geometry is also editable as raw JSON in the Notes panel.
Eleven ArcGIS widgets plus a custom Expand button on a 360px map; the custom button overlaps the widget stack and the map is chrome-heavy on small screens.
GPS autofill calls the public ArcGIS geocoder directly from the browser and guesses the route from any 1–3 digit number in the address text, silently overwriting county/district/route.
Photo popup exposes the raw section_key (e.g. 'water_drainage') instead of the section label used everywhere else.
Evidence counts appear three times (header pill, header button, hero legend) and are fetched twice.
Latitude/Longitude have no min/max or inline validation; bad values only fail on Save with a header-level error.
Stored-value tiles explain their format only via title tooltips, invisible on touch.

strengths: State Plane N/E is hidden behind a toggle and auto-derives from lat/lon (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:120-128,172-208)
Legend swatches match the actual map symbols and include live counts (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:229-249)
Geometry autosave has role=status feedback and error colouring (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:211-215)
Inputs have htmlFor labels, type=number and inputMode=decimal (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:143-169)
Camera-heading wedges are drawn only when the backend quality gate kept the heading, so the map never invents orientation (SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:491-528)
Optional Caltrans highways layer is opt-in by env and sits under the overlays (SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:36-45,134-143)

roles: All users see the cards; inputs are wrapped in <fieldset disabled> unless canEdit (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:108,725)
Layout tools (drag, resize, Tidy, Reset, Full screen) are available to every role, including read-only viewers (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:762-794)

responsive.layout: Absolutely positioned pixel canvas. Cards are a fixed 520px wide (report header 1052px when two columns fit); auto-fit column count = floor((containerWidth-12)/532), so one column below ~1076px. Card heights are fixed pixels (250–980) with overflow-auto bodies. The canvas container is min-w-0 overflow-x-auto.
breakpointsUsed: md:inline for the drag hint only (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:769)
no Tailwind grid breakpoints; layout is computed in JS (submissionLayoutModel.ts:69-70,93-96,117-152; useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:136-150,287-295)
phoneRisks: Every card is 520px wide on a 375px viewport: the right ~145px of each card (attachment button, second input column) is clipped until the user side-scrolls the canvas (submissionLayoutModel.ts:69; useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:287-295; SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:797)

Fixed card heights with inner overflow-auto create nested scroll regions inside the page scroll; touch scrolling gets trapped inside cards (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:106; submissionLayoutModel.ts:28-40)
Drag/resize are mouse-only; the toolbar still shows Tidy/Reset/Full screen and the cursor-grab header, which do nothing useful on touch (useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:154-194)
Chips are text-xs px-2.5 py-1 (~26px tall) and icon buttons in Distribution are the only comfortably sized targets (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:61,955)
Free-text date inputs bring up the full keyboard instead of a date picker (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:803,807)
tabletRisks: At 768–1024px the canvas is one 520px column with ~250–500px of dead space to the right; the report header cannot span two columns so its 300px height forces internal scrolling for district contacts (submissionLayoutModel.ts:29,93-104)
Resize handles are 6px wide hover targets, effectively unusable with a finger (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:112-113)
desktopNotes: Two columns from ~1076px container width, three from ~1608px; skyline flow packs cards by height (submissionLayoutModel.ts:117-152)
Custom layouts persist per browser in localStorage under eris_submission_layout_v2 (useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:110-120; submissionLayoutModel.ts:68)
Transitions of 160ms on left/top/width/height when not dragging (useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:281)

painPoints.issue: Fixed 520px card width on an absolute canvas means horizontal scrolling and clipped inputs on any viewport narrower than ~545px; the form is effectively unusable on a phone.
Draggable/resizable dashboard tooling (Tidy, Reset, Full screen, custom layout pill, localStorage persistence) adds cognitive load to what is a checklist form, and none of it works on touch.
Fixed card heights force nested scrolling: Measurements defaults to 980px holding a 460px 3D scene + diagram + 8 inputs; Report Header is 300px with an expanding contacts accordion.
Report Date and Date Incident Reported are free-text 'YYYY-MM-DD' inputs rather than type=date.

Invisible cross-panel dependency: 'Open Highway Traffic Lanes' appears only when the OPEN_HIGHWAY_TRAFFIC chip in the Notes panel (far below) is selected; highway status chips appear only after typing a cause.
Toggle chips convey selected state by colour only (brand border/text vs line), with no aria-pressed and no check glyph.
Most card labels are <label> elements without htmlFor, so inputs are unlabeled for assistive tech.
Material soil percentages must total 100% but this is checked only when Submit is pressed, and the error appears in the header banner rather than on the card.
Contact accordion uses '>' / 'v' text as disclosure glyphs with no aria-expanded; 'Raw Contact Data' exposes a JSON textarea to end users.
Read-only viewers still see chips styled as buttons; the disabled fieldset only dims them, giving no explicit 'read only' cue.
Distribution icon gets src='' when a lookup code has no icon mapping, producing a broken image.
Water/Drainage card mixes drainage condition with adjacent-impact assessment (utilities/properties/structures), which the data dictionary treats as separate sections K and L.

strengths: Card sections mirror the paper GISA sheet and the data dictionary sections A–M (submissionLayoutModel.ts:42-54; docs/GISA_DATA_DICTIONARY.md:32-168)
Conditional reveal keeps cards short: Cracks→dimensions, Rock→subtypes, Soil→percentages, Flowing→Seep/Spring, Lanes closed→count (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1042-1056,1069-1076,1124-1129,991-999)
District→County→Route cascading selects with normalised lookups prevent invalid combinations (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:809-858; caltransLookups)
Per-section 'Open attachments (n)' ties mobile-captured photos to the exact section (SubmissionSectionAttachmentsDialog.tsx:8-20; submissionAttachmentModel.ts:39-49)
Distribution uses pictograms, matching how geologists recognise movement types (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:945-963)
Layout persistence is versioned and defensively normalised so stale layouts cannot break the page (submissionLayoutModel.ts:189-236)
Full-screen mode is a proper role=dialog with Escape and body scroll lock (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1236; useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:122-134)

responsive.layout: Scene is a fixed 460px-tall block at the top of a 520px-wide, 980px-tall canvas card whose body scrolls internally; diagram and inputs follow below inside the same scrolling card. Inputs use auto-fit minmax(220px,1fr).
phoneRisks: Scene captures wheel/touch for camera control inside a card that scrolls inside a page that scrolls: three nested scroll/gesture surfaces (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:106; InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:402-403)

Controls are 9–10px text (overlay chips text-[9px], buttons text-[10px], sample button text-[10px]) far below legibility and touch minimums (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:420,427,436,444,531,542; SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:63,71)
A high-quality SceneView (qualityProfile 'high') is mounted automatically for every viewer, heavy on mobile GPUs and data (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:161)
The 520px card is clipped at 375px, so the scene's right-hand controls are off-screen (see canvas blocker)
tabletRisks: Card inner scroll hides the measurement inputs ~700px below the top of the card; users may not realise the inputs exist
Native Fullscreen API generally unavailable on iPadOS Safari for arbitrary elements, so the fixed inset-0 CSS fallback is used (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:319-344; terrainScene.ts:397-401)
desktopNotes: Scene is stable across parent re-renders thanks to the anchorKey pattern; camera does not reset while typing (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:90-99,204-208)

painPoints.issue: The card is titled 'Measurements' but opens with a 460px 3D scene; the diagram and the eight inputs the card exists for are pushed below an internal scroll.
9–10px control text inside the scene and the sample button; 8px attribution.
Scene camera gestures conflict with the card's overflow-auto and the page scroll (nested scroll trap).
A heavyweight ArcGIS SceneView is auto-mounted on every visit for every role, even reviewers who only need the checklist.
'Sample terrain' is outside the disabled fieldset, so read-only viewers can trigger a server-side sampling job with no explanation of what it does or confirmation.
Error and warning copy still refers to 'the USGS sampled-relief card below', which was removed from this view.
Measurement input labels lack htmlFor; the diagram's symbol names (alpha, beta) are spelled out while the image shows Greek letters.
Two identical spinners (lazy chunk Suspense + scene loading) can flash back-to-back.

strengths: Overlay chips are disabled with line-through when no real data backs them, so the scene never invents geometry (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:517-536; terrainScene.ts:106-128)
Health probing distinguishes blocking failure (Retry) from non-blocking warnings (terrainScene.ts:353-387; InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:118-127)
Stable SceneView anchor prevents camera resets on parent re-render (terrainScene.ts:55-65; InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:90-99)
Clear empty state when coordinates are missing tells the user how to fix it (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:381-395)
Fullscreen API with CSS fallback and Esc/native sync (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:319-379)
Deep link ?section=terrain for cross-page navigation (SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:28-37)

desktopNotes: Always-open cards replace the previous collapsed <details> (SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:29-33)

painPoints.issue: Reviewer note is written at the bottom of the page but consumed by Approve/Return buttons in the header.
Summary timestamps are raw ISO strings while Workflow History formats its timestamps.
Descriptor and Status duplicated a third time; raw 'Event <TYPE>' and 'Actor user #N' shown.

strengths: Always-open cards with explanatory subtitles (SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:29-61; SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:24,38)
Sharing copy explains that it does not change ownership or edit rights (SubmissionAccessSharing.tsx:33)
Workflow comments are shown inline under each transition (SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:60-64)

crossCutting: Vocabulary: the same location facts appear in three formats (h1 descriptor '03-SAC-050-12.3', hero raw codes with tooltips, Report Header 'District 3' + county name, scene summary 'Rte 050 · PM'); status appears as badge, caption prose and a Summary row; evidence counts appear in three places (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:74,102,105; SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:135-138,237-247; SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:826,845,1292,1298; terrainScene.ts:441-442).

Role gating bypasses the role model: the page hard-codes 'FIELD_WORKER', 'REVIEWER', 'ADMIN' strings (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:161-168) while roleModel.ts defines canonical aliases (GEOTECH_ENGINEER ↔ FIELD_WORKER) and hasRole/isEngineer helpers that go unused here; the route itself is ProtectedRoute, not RoleRoute, so any authenticated user (including maintenance-only) can open a submission (App.tsx:135-142).

Decision inputs are separated from their actions: submit comment (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1282-1284) and reviewer note (1301-1307) sit at the bottom of a page whose Submit / Approve / Return buttons are in the header (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:126-142).

Mixed persistence models on one form: map sketches PATCH immediately (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:399-424), 'Sample terrain' writes server-side immediately from any role (SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:39-53), everything else waits for Save draft (332-364), and Refresh discards unsaved edits with no dirty indicator or beforeunload guard.

Two layout philosophies on one page: a pixel-fixed absolute canvas (520px cards, 360px map, 460px scene; submissionLayoutModel.ts:22-40,69; SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:259; InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:73) versus fluid auto-fit grids for Notes, library and review cards (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1250; SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:394; SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:65). Only the fluid parts work on a 375px phone.

Three independent full-screen implementations with their own Escape handling and body-overflow locks: canvas (fixed inset-0 z-40, useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:122-134; SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1236), 2D map modal (fixed inset-0 z-50, SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:573-604), 3D scene (Fullscreen API + fixed z-50 fallback, InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:319-379; terrainScene.ts:397-401).

Button style zoo, at least eight recipes: header btn (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:26), primary brand (129,138), red outline (135), toolbarButton (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:63), chip/ynChip (61-62), tinted action chips (1276-1277), hero buttons (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:114,124), Remove Contact / Add District Contact (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:903,936), section attachment button (SubmissionSectionAttachmentsDialog.tsx:15), scene 10px white/85 buttons (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:420-447), sample-terrain 10px button (SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:71), library tabs (SubmissionLibrary.tsx:48-52).

Accessibility gaps: <label> without htmlFor across all canvas cards (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:59,802-870,1051-1054,1071-1078,1092-1094,1112-1114,1146-1153); toggle chips lack aria-pressed and use colour-only selection (61-62,1276-1277); drag/resize are mouse-only with aria-hidden handles and no keyboard alternative (95-120; useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:154-194); contact accordion uses '>'/'v' text with no aria-expanded (884-891); 9–10px text in the scene (InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:420-447,531-542); title-only hints on hero tiles and the header photo button (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:135-138; SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:119); '•••' menu is not a menu (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:146-156); most buttons are below 44px.

Raw ids and codes surfaced to users: 'owner user #N' (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1174), 'Actor user #N' and 'Event <RAW_TYPE>' (SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:52), attachment '#id' (SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:287), 'Submission #N' in the scene (SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:99), raw section_key in map popups (SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:101), 'Submission ID' row (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1293), stored district/county/route codes in the hero (SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:135-137).

Dead or legacy code: SubmissionDetailPrimitives exports compatibility aliases S and Section that the page no longer uses (SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:68-79; only R is imported, SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:16); submissionDetailModel re-exports layout constants 'so existing imports keep working' (submissionDetailModel.ts:136-150); DASHBOARD_DEFAULT_ORDER and DASHBOARD_DEFAULT_SIZES still carry the removed 'location' card (submissionLayoutModel.ts:6,30,73-74); terrainSceneErrorMessage references a removed 'USGS sampled-relief card below' (terrainScene.ts:311-319; SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:9-12); layout v1 storage key is orphaned by design (submissionLayoutModel.ts:65-68).

Data-model fields round-tripped but never shown: distribution_advancing/retrogressive/enlarging/widening/moving/confined Tri flags are loaded and saved (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:297,351; submissionDetailModel.ts:18-23) but the Distribution card edits distribution_code instead; est_soil_pct is loaded/saved with no input (299,353). The data dictionary also lists material_pavement_type, est_boulder_pct and est_debris_* with no UI (docs/GISA_DATA_DICTIONARY.md:103,113-117).

Dates are free-text 'YYYY-MM-DD' inputs rather than type=date (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:802-807), and lat/lon, EA, Project ID, Post Mile have no inline validation; all errors funnel to one header banner (1205).

Duplicate network work: photo evidence fetched by both the header and the page (SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:64; SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:254); Save draft and Sample terrain each trigger a full reload of submission, lookups and geometry (262-269,366; SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:47).

Loading and feedback: plain 'Loading...' text for the page (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1207), two stacked spinners for the 3D scene, no 'saved' toast, window.confirm for delete followed by a hard navigation (428-438).

Layout tooling shown to touch users who cannot use it: the toolbar hint is hidden below md but Tidy/Reset/Full screen and cursor-grab headers remain (SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:762-794,97); the canvas has no responsive fallback (no stacked/accordion mode) for narrow viewports.
